title: Buyer Personas — Overview
summary: Fictional but research-based profiles representing key customer archetypes.
body:
Fictional but research-based profiles representing key customer archetypes. Standard in product and content marketing.

Approaches commonly used alongside it include Jobs to Be Done, Empathy Map, Segmentation Bases.
